title: Code and data for "Testing CCZ-equivalence to permutations via projections of Walsh zero spaces, with applications to APN functions"

creators.name: Bellini, Emanuele
creators.affiliation: Technology Innovation Institute, Abu Dhabi, UAE

description: Scripts, C and Python sources, generated data and expected results of the paper by E. Bellini, "Testing CCZ-equivalence to permutations via projections of Walsh zero spaces, with applications to APN functions", submitted to Cryptography and Communications. The repository contains the projection test for CCZ-equivalence to a permutation, the exact switching closure with EA-equivalence certificates, the searches for the family x^3 + a^-1 Tr(a^3 x^9) up to dimension 22, and one script per experiment, with verify.py and check_certificates.py to check the reported numbers and certificates.
